title: Kiritani Haruka — Summer! Training Camp! Swimsuit!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: Chasing The Sparkle Beyond the Blue Sky

rows.Line: Cafe

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Ready, everyone...?
Here's to a great training camp.

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Cheers!!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm glad that our training camp went so well.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Me too. Many of our viewers have even been writing about how much they enjoyed everything.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! As for me, I learned so much and got in so many good workouts! I feel like I've grown so much compared to before our training camp!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. You really did give it all you had.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hehe...
Oh, our parfaits are here!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, I ordered the Deluxe Fruit Parfait.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And I got the Strawberries Galore Red Parfait!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Your parfait really is like a mountain of strawberries, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You could say the same for yours, Shizuku. All I can see are slices of peaches and pears.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, wanna trade for some of my warabimochi?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: How about some of my mangoes, Airi? Feel free to ask if you see any fruits that you want to try.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, totally! The four of us may be celebrating together, but this is also to congratulate you on a job well done!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, you sure?
Then, I might just have to say yes to that.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That was delicious.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow, I'm stuffed!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But I ended up eating a ton of whipped cream, so I'll have to work all of that off later.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
R-Right. Maybe I should exercise a little more than usual today.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, Minori, that reminds me. You've continued training since then, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yup! I've been running to increase my stamina and doing core workouts to build my inner muscles!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That's wonderful, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. If I keep this up, do you think I'll be able to get a six-pack in time for our solo show?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Just what exactly are you trying to become...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka & Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Anyway, now that we're done with our parfaits, let's get some tea or coffee to cleanse our palates...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hm...? Why are you all grinning like that...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. We were all just thinking the same thing. Right, Minori?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yup!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Excuse me! We're ready!

rows.Speaker: Waiter
rows.Line:
Here you are.
The Special “Nice work, Airi” Tea Set!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh? A special tea set...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. We asked the staff if they could put together a special menu item just for today!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Which includes this lovely tea and...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: These cookies.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: C-Cookies! That look like cats...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Th-They're so adorable...!
And they all have different expressions on their faces!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: How were you able to make these?! They must've taken...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The three of us designed them together before heading off for our training camp, and asked the staff here to bake them for us.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We had a feeling that you'd like them because you love cats so much, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. The staff here are really great at baking cookies, so I'm sure they're really yummy!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, they certainly smell nice. I can already tell that they're delicious...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: B-But I'm not sure I can eat them! They're just so cute!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Also, this is a ton of cookies.
Are you sure we can get through all of these?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Actually, the staff said that we could take them home with us, so we had them bake a fairly big batch.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
We can take these home?!
That's so nice of them!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But first, I gotta take some pictures of these...! This one... And this one... Oh, this one's cute too!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm so glad we put so much effort into drawing those cats.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Me too. I believe this means our surprise succeeded.

rows.Speaker: Haruka, Shizuku & Minori
rows.Line: Yay!
